thread.title: ACC changes quarterfinal schedule due to expected weather
thread.title_full: ACC changes quarterfinal schedule due to expected weather

author: Bay State News
title: ACC changes quarterfinal schedule due to expected weather
text:
The Atlantic Coast Conference announced on May 20 that the first two games of the upcoming ACC quarterfinals will be rescheduled to earlier times because of anticipated weather conditions in the area tomorrow night. The games, originally set for later, will now take place at 11 a.m. and 3 p.m.
This adjustment affects several teams, including Boston College, which is now scheduled to play at 3 p.m. against the winner of today’s game between Miami and Stanford.
The conference said this decision was made to ensure player safety and avoid potential disruptions caused by inclement weather. The ACC regularly monitors weather patterns during its tournaments and has previously adjusted schedules when necessary.
Such changes can impact team preparations as well as fan attendance, but organizers say these measures are important for maintaining fairness and safety during tournament play.
Further updates regarding any additional schedule changes will be provided by the ACC if necessary.
